newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Prague says to tap mkts for $200-250mln in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Prague says to tap mkts for $200-250mln in 1997.

text.p: The city of Prague will tap foreign and domestic sources for some $200-250 million in 1997 to finance road and housing construction, Prague Mayor Jan Koukal said on Wednesday.

"We will make a decision on what kind of instruments to use...(but) we want to issue bonds in foreign currencies. It will be definitely this year, it depends on the exchange rate situation," he told a news conference.
He gave no further details of the plans.
He added that funds will also be given to individual city districts.
The city of Prague carries a foreign currency debt rating of A from the Standard and Poor's agency.
